description: Import CSV, TSV and Excel .xlsx files into Filament v4 and v5 resources with no queue: encoding and delimiter detection, header matching, upserts and a failed-rows report.
rules: Import the action as RomanSulzhyk\FilamentImport\Actions\ExcelImportAction; its default action name is excelImport.

Import runs synchronously in the request with no queue; files over syncRowLimit (default 2,000 rows) are refused, so raise it only after measuring or use Filament's queued core ImportAction for large files.
Old .xls files are refused; ask users to save as .xlsx or CSV UTF-8.
validateUsing(), upsertBy(), importColumns() and exceptColumns() configure zero-config mode only; with ->importer(SomeImporter::class) put columns, rules and relationships in the Importer class.
eightynine/filament-excel-import methods such as ->use(), processCollectionUsing() and mutateBeforeValidationUsing() do not exist in this package.
